job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is a Delaware Office of the State Treasurer RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping, not KCERA’s RFP for audit services. Its five-year term and discretionary extension options do not support the requested KCERA contract term.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER

The original term of the contract between the successful Vendor and the State shall be five (5) years, beginning date to be determined, with OST having three one-year extension options, each exercisable in OST’s sole discretion, subject only to necessary Board approval.
